notes: Shelf "Dryers" rebuilt as three tier kinds. Old k71 (vented) and k72 (condenser/heat-pump) merged into one Tumble dryer kind with the technology as types (vented, condenser, heat-pump, gas, integrated, compact), sourced to the Wikipedia Clothes dryer article. Models (10) are drawn from independent testers retrieved this session: Reviewed.com best dryers 2026 (Electrolux ELFE7637AT best overall, Maytag MED7230HW best value, LG DLEX6700B best upgrade), Trusted Reviews best tumble dryers (Samsung Series 9 DV90T8240SX, Hoover H-DRY 500, Hisense DHGA901NL) and Consumer Reports' recently-tested list (Speed Queen DR3004WE, Whirlpool WED4107SW, Miele TWD360WP, GE Profile PFD95ESPWDS). Which? Best Buy model names are paywalled; its public page states all current top scorers are AEG, which I could not attach to a specific model, so AEG/Bosch/Beko appear in the brand register only (Bosch and Beko as market-covering brands). Spin dryer kept kind-level: old models retained plus the Laundry Alternative Nina Soft confirmed on the maker site; Thomas Centri and G3 Ferrari Monia carried over from old data. Bedding dryer trimmed to six models taken from the kakaku.com futon-dryer sales ranking (Zojirushi, Hitachi, Iris Ohyama, cado, Mitsubishi Pokasara Plus AD-PS70BB, Panasonic FD-F06S2); old Mitsubishi Pokasara base/Pro and cado FOEHN PRO dropped as unconfirmed this session. cado has no Wikipedia page retrieved so it is not in the brand register (model kept in m). Bathroom ceiling dryers were not present in the old data; nothing moved. LG Styler (clothing-care cabinet) and drying cabinets left out as not planned kinds for this shelf. No archetypes used (tier shelf), so no archetype sources required; no artisan traditions apply.
